text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['f31'] <= df['f40']"],"features":["f31","f40"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the source address and service are a subset of connections matching the source address."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['f34'] <= df['f40']"],"features":["f34","f40"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the source address and destination port are a subset of connections matching the source address."},{"id":"R3","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['f36'] <= df['f40']) & (df['f36'] <= df['f33'])"],"features":["f36","f40","f33"],"rationale":"Connections matching a particular source-destination address pair are a subset of connections matching either address individually."},{"id":"R4","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['f41'] <= df['f33']"],"features":["f41","f33"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the destination address and service are a subset of connections matching the destination address."},{"id":"R5","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['f35'] <= df['f33']"],"features":["f35","f33"],"rationale":"Connections matching both the destination address and source port are a subset of connections matching the destination address."},{"id":"R6","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['f37'] == 0) | (df['f38'] >= 1)"],"features":["f37","f38"],"rationale":"An FTP session accessed using a username and password must contain at least one FTP command."}]}
